audit_items.proof_trace: The 50% threshold is enforced through layered validation: (1) verify_data_column_sidecar ensures column.len() == kzg_commitments.len() for each sidecar, (2) verify_sidecar_inclusion_proof cryptographically binds all sidecars to identical kzg_commitments via Merkle proof against body_root, (3) callers check available_columns.len() * 2 < NumberOfColumns ensuring ≥64 columns. Since all columns have identical blob counts and ≥64 columns are required, each blob receives exactly ≥64 cells for recovery.
